content.value_statement: Image workflows often need fast visuals and accurate text rendering from one repeatable tool. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to run Qwen-Image through inference.sh.
actual_capabilities: Runs Qwen-Image-2.0 and Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro through the infsh CLI.
Generates one or more images from text prompts.
Edits images using one to three reference image URLs.
Sets width, height, seed, watermark, negative prompt, and prompt extension options.
Guides model selection for faster drafts or stronger text rendering.
limitations: Requires an installed inference.sh CLI and a working login.
Sends prompts and reference image URLs to the inference.sh service.
Output quality depends on Qwen model behavior and prompt detail.
Image size and count must stay within the app constraints.

use_cases.title: Create Design Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate style directions, mood images, and visual alternatives before detailed design work begins.

use_cases.title: Draft Marketing Visuals
use_cases.description: Produce campaign images, poster concepts, and text-heavy layouts using the Pro model.

use_cases.title: Prototype Product Imagery
use_cases.description: Create placeholder product scenes or edited reference composites for planning and review.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use qwen-image to create one image of [subject] in [style]. Keep the settings simple.

prompt_templates.title: Create Several Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate four variations of [concept] with a consistent [style], [mood], and [color palette].

prompt_templates.title: Design a Text Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro to create a poster with the exact text [text]. Disable prompt extension for accuracy.

prompt_templates.title: Edit With References
prompt_templates.prompt: Use three reference image URLs to combine [person], [outfit], and [pose] into one image. Explain the settings before running.

output_examples.input: Create a watercolor mountain landscape at sunrise.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects Qwen-Image-2.0, uses a landscape resolution, and returns generated image results from inference.sh.

output_examples.input: Make four logo concepts for a coffee shop.
output_examples.output: The assistant requests multiple images and returns several visual options for comparison.

output_examples.input: Create a sale poster with exact headline and subtitle text.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects the Pro model, keeps prompt extension off, and prioritizes text placement and readability.

best_practices: Use the Pro model when exact text rendering matters.
Provide clear subject, style, composition, lighting, and size requirements.
Use a seed when you need repeatable visual results.
anti_patterns: Do not submit private images unless external processing is acceptable.
Do not expect exact text layout from vague poster prompts.
Do not request sizes or image counts outside the documented limits.

faq.question: What does this skill use to generate images?
faq.answer: It uses the inference.sh infsh CLI to run Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0 apps.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports reference-based editing with one to three image URLs.

faq.question: Which model should I choose for text in images?
faq.answer: Use Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro for posters, titles, and other text-heavy designs.

faq.question: Does it require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The inference.sh CLI must be installed and logged in before use.

faq.question: Can it generate multiple images at once?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents generating one to six images when the app supports it.

faq.question: Is sensitive input safe to use?
faq.answer: Use caution. Prompts and reference image URLs are sent to an external service.
